explain.analyzed: EXPLAIN ANALYZE really ran this query and rolled it back, so table data is unchanged (sequence counters such as nextval are not rolled back). The whole plan read {pages} pages.

notSimulated.multiple: Cannot explain: EXPLAIN works on exactly one SQL statement. Not simulated.
notSimulated.empty: Cannot explain: there is no SQL statement. Not simulated.
notSimulated.unsupported: Cannot explain: only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and MERGE can be explained. Not simulated.
notSimulated.parserUnavailable: Cannot explain: the SQL parser has not finished loading, so the statement cannot be checked safely. Not simulated.
notSimulated.inTransaction: Cannot explain: the session has an open transaction and EXPLAIN ANALYZE would have to roll it back. COMMIT or ROLLBACK first. Not simulated.
